name: Nova

attributes.note: Coachmen publishes no MSRP for the Nova. The displayed $178,801 is the dealer MSRP for the 2026 20RB, recorded October 14, 2026 from two independent dealers and re-corroborated October 16, 2026 in current dealer listings; it is labeled a dealer listing wherever it appears. A 2027 20RB lists at $195,170 at one dealer, and advertised sale prices run far below MSRP across the line.

Coachmen's published spec tables list no sleeping capacity; dealer spec tables rate the Nova at 2. Every current floor plan offers an optional pop-top with an upper berth (a manufacturer option on Coachmen's features page), so a Nova can sleep more only by adding the pop-top.

attributes.value: Wet bath with fiberglass shower; flush toilet to a black tank on every floor plan (no cassette toilet)
3 Group 31 AGM, 345 Ah total (115 Ah each)
attributes.note: The optional Li Lithium Battery System replaces the AGM bank with a 640 Ah Lithionics lithium battery with internal heater, a second under-hood alternator and a 3,000W Xantrex XC Pro inverter/charger, and deletes the Onan generator.

attributes.value: 2,000W Xantrex inverter with Auto Gen Start
Rockwool R-15 insulation standard; fresh and black tanks above floor; optional Cozy Wrap insulation and grey tank heaters; Truma Combi Eco Plus
220W standard (dual 110W roof panels); the optional pop-top carries its own 190W panel

notes: Current lineup re-verified October 16, 2026 on coachmenrv.com: 20C, 20D and 20RB (the 20X no longer appears on Coachmen's site). Specs were re-verified against Coachmen's own floor plan pages (chassis, fresh water, fuel and GVWR upgraded from dealer-only to manufacturer figures) and its features page: fresh water is 27 gal on all three floor plans, gray is 20 gal (20C/20D) or 23 gal (20RB), black is 19 gal (20C/20D) or 10 gal (20RB), so every Nova has a flush toilet and a black tank and none has a cassette. Coachmen publishes no MSRP and no sleeping capacity or interior height in its spec tables; the price displayed is a dealer MSRP reference (see the startingPrice note) and sleeping capacity is dealer-rated at 2. No Nova warranty figure was verified from a manufacturer source, so none is published.
